acceptanceCriteria: A run where a non-target case fails retains that case's report, shown by a test.
Retained output stays bounded and excludes secrets.
body: Seen in RC3 lane E (V1-0397 non-reproduction, PR beamfall/corvint#741, 2026-10-10): 200 HLQ claude-code runs with corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 0, N-1 rc.2 build 360, adapter 0.3.1, Claude Code 2.1.293, darwin/arm64 M2 Max, load1 52-259 (median 122) from 8 yes burners plus 2 loops. Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-10-v1-0397-upgrade-sessionstart-nonrepro.md and docs/build-log/evidence/v1-0397/runs.tsv on that branch. The runner removes reports when the case under study passes, so intermittent failures in other cases (7 uninstall failures, 11 Stop fail-opens) lost their failure text. Proposal: keep reports for any failed case, bounded in size, or add an option to do so.
title: HLQ runner should retain the report of any failed case even when the run's target case passes
